item.title: Gérard Depardieu Is Ordered to Stand Trial Over Rape Accusation
item.description: The actress Charlotte Arnould has accused the French movie star of raping her in 2018. He has denied any wrongdoing in the case.

item.title: El Salvador’s Nayib Bukele Elates Haiti With Fight Against Gangs
item.description: The president of El Salvador has widespread support among Haitians, who are tired of violence and hope he can be the one to finally end it.

item.title: Why Russia Is Erasing Stalin’s Crimes
item.description: Across Russia, memorials to victims of Joseph Stalin’s repressive regime are being quietly dismantled as more and more critics of the war in Ukraine are jailed. Our Moscow correspondent Valerie Hopkins takes us to one example of this erasure.
